subject: [PATCH 2/2] mm/mempolicy: stop copying the nodemask in the interleave paths

2026-08-29.patch_summary: This patch removes the unnecessary copying of a nodemask in interleave node selectors, reducing memory usage and improving performance. The copy was only used to ensure consistency between the node count and the walk, but this is no longer necessary as bounds checking can be used instead. If an empty nodelist or weight is detected, the code falls back to using numa_node_id(). This change also removes a now-unused function read_once_policy_nodemask() and results in significant reductions in stack usage for certain functions.
